candidateAudit.title: Artificial intelligence is often framed as a quest to replicate the human brain, promising frictionless cognition and a future of seamless automation. But what if this pervasive na
candidateAudit.text: Artificial intelligence is often framed as a quest to replicate the human brain, promising frictionless cognition and a future of seamless automation. But what if this pervasive narrative obscures a deeper, more ‘errant’ truth? Media theorist and author Clemens Apprich in conversation with philosopher Jan Völker. Moderated by Amanda Holmes, Department of Philosophy, University of Applied Arts Vienna Welcome: Ulrike Kuch, Rector of the University of Applied Arts Vienna A cooperation of the department of Media Theory and the department of Philosophy. ‘Errant Intelligence’ challenges the prevailing biological and individualistic interpretations of machine learning, arguing instead for a radical understanding of machine intelligence. The book embraces the deviations, inconsistencies, and ‘errant behaviour’ as fundamental to the discovery of new knowledge, moving beyond the illusion of mere optimisation. Drawing on media theory, cybernetics, and a unique psychoanalytic lens, it explores the ‘technological unconscious’ of machine learning. It traces the historical roots of AI, from early automatons and the Turing machine to natural language processing and contemporary machine learning systems. Challenging the idea of an autonomous, self-generating AI, the book exposes the hidden labour, assumed logics, and inherent biases that animate its operation. It re-evaluates computational thinking, insisting on its inherently social, collective, and symbolic character, and revealing how language and logical paradoxes are not obstacles but constitutive forces that shape intelligent machines

Bietet dir die Airline nichts Brauchbares an, darfst du selbst buchen und dir die Kosten zurückholen (OGH 1 Ob 133/18t). ✈️ 3️⃣ BETREUUNG: Während du wartest, zahlt die Airline Essen & Getränke, bei Übernachtung Hotel + Transfer und 2 Telefonate/E-Mails. candidateAudit.text: In this workshop with Helena Detsch we will explore simple ways to create a fascinating natural color palette from soil and plant-based materials like earths, minerals, vegetables, kitchen supplies and algae pigments. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ Duration: 15:30–17:30 Please register for this workshop via link in bio (free entry) Together, we'll first experiment with making self-made oil- or watercolors from 100% natural sources and then explore the many possibilities of sustainable painting, discovering how these self-made colors behave on paper and fabric and what a truly organic painting practice can look like. In her oil paintings, installations and animations, Helena Detsch explores (mis-)relationships between humans and more-than-human life. Her series and immersive spatial installations question Western anthropocentric narratives about nature as a resource and create spaces to reflect on coexistence and complex interconnections between human and other agents. candidateAudit.text: 🚨 Austrian-Langstrecke OS 41 Wien → Washington: 2 Tage in Folge massiv verspätet! ✈️ Gestern (26.09.) landete OS 41 erst um 17:28 statt 14:00 Uhr in Washington – 3 Stunden 28 Minuten zu spät. Wichtig: Kommst du weniger als 4 Stunden zu spät an, darf die Airline auf 300 € kürzen. candidateAudit.title: About the next exhibition at AIL: Soil is a highly diverse and sensitive cosmos that is facing increasing pressure due to the climate crisis, as a result of more frequent and sever
candidateAudit.text: About the next exhibition at AIL: Soil is a highly diverse and sensitive cosmos that is facing increasing pressure due to the climate crisis, as a result of more frequent and severe extreme events such as drought. Soil holds histories, stories and belowground storage systems, repositories of information and traces of past worlds, current developments and future scenarios. What is happening beneath our feet? At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphors. With contributions by: Franziska Allerberger (Geographer), Michael Bahn (Ecologist), Helena Detsch (Visual Artist), Cornelia Dirnberger (Visual Artist), Christian Prohammer (Musician, Audio Engineer), Nora Schöpfer (Visual Artist), Konstantina Maria Serjannis (Cultural Scientist), Johanna Unterpertinger (Musician) ’03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). Join the extended exhibition program: 6 Oct Exhibition Opening with Performances by Michael Bahn, Johanna Unterpertinger and Christian Prohammer 8 Oct 15:30–17:30 Workshop with Helena Detsch The Organic Painter – Painting

candidateAudit.title: 🚨 Langstrecke gestrichen: OS 38 Newark → Wien (geplante Ankunft heute, 22.09., 07:50 Uhr) wurde annulliert! Über 6.800 km – und dann fällt der Flug aus? Wenn du betroffen bist, me
candidateAudit.text: 🚨 Langstrecke gestrichen: OS 38 Newark → Wien (geplante Ankunft heute, 22.09., 07:50 Uhr) wurde annulliert! Über 6.800 km – und dann fällt der Flug aus? Wenn du betroffen bist, merk dir diese 3 Ansprüche nach der EU-Fluggastrechte-Verordnung 261/2004: 👇 1️⃣ ENTSCHÄDIGUNG: Bei Annullierung stehen dir je nach Flugdistanz 250 €, 400 € oder 600 € zu – für die Langstrecke Newark–Wien (über 3.500 km) sind das bis zu 600 € pro Person. Die vollen 600 € gibt's, wenn dich dein Ersatzflug 4 Stunden oder mehr nach der geplanten Zeit ans Ziel bringt – sonst darf die Airline um die Hälfte kürzen. Ausnahmen (z. B. außergewöhnliche Umstände oder Info mehr als 14 Tage vor Abflug) muss die AIRLINE beweisen, nicht du. 💪 2️⃣ ERSATZFLUG ODER GELD ZURÜCK: Du hast die Wahl – volle Ticket-Erstattung binnen 7 Tagen ODER schnellstmögliche Ersatzbeförderung, notfalls auch mit einer anderen Airline. Bietet dir die Airline nichts Brauchbares an, darfst du selbst buchen und dir die Kosten zurückholen (OGH 1 Ob 133/18t). ✈️ 3️⃣ BETREUUNG: Während du wartest, zahlt die Airline Essen & Getränke, bei Übernachtung Hotel + Transfer und 2 Telefonate/E-Mails – auch in New York. Ninja-Tipp: Alle Belege aufheben! 🧾 Wichtig: Die Entschädigung aus Punkt 1 bekommst du ZUSÄTZLICH zu Ersatzflug/Erstattung – das eine schließt das andere nicht aus. 🥷 👉 Betroffen? Prüf deinen Anspruch kostenlos in 2 Minuten auf flugninja.at – 100 % risikofrei, keine Vorkosten. Hol dir, was dir zusteht! Hinweis: Allgemeine Information, keine Rechtsberatung im Einzelfall. Der Grund der Annullierung ist derzeit nicht bestätigt. #flugg

candidateAudit.text: We keep on digging and the next artistic research exhibition will open in October – Save the date and join us! Soil is a highly diverse and sensitive cosmos that is facing increasing pressure due to the climate crisis, as a result of more frequent and severe extreme events such as drought. Soil holds histories, stories and belowground storage systems, repositories of information and traces of past worlds, current developments and future scenarios. ’03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphors. With contributions by: Franziska Allerberger (Geographer), Michael Bahn (Ecologist), Helena Detsch (Visual Artist), Cornelia Dirnberger (Visual Artist), Christian Prohammer (Musician, Audio Engineer), Nora Schöpfer (Visual Artist), Konstantina Maria Serjannis (Cultural Scientist), Johanna Unterpertinger (Musician) Opening Program, 6 Oct 18:00 Welcome by Julienne Lorz expanded_museum_studies (Expanded Museum Studies, AIL Executive Board) and introduction by Soil team members 19:00 Soil rememb

candidateAudit.text: Coming up next as part of VIENNA DESIGN WEEK 2026 🪢 The exhibition ’Zero and One Chairs’ was created as part of MATCH!, a recurring initiative organised by the department of Applied Photography and Time-Based Media at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, which explores the synergistic potential of student teams from different degree programs. In collaboration with the department Industrial Design, this year’s focus was on the intersection of photography and the object, with particular attention paid to the relationship with set design, styling, casting and narrative. Seen from the perspective of Applied Photography, the object and thus the chair, is a welcome protagonist. Photography’s multiple applied genres are cited here: documentary, fashion, advertising, architecture and the portrait. When the function in Industrial Design coalesces with the idea of the purpose in Applied Photography, the question of factuality emerges. Be not mistaken: The most literal things are often the most confusing and enigmatic. Between what it is and how it is*, worlds unfold. We put the images to work. VDW Cocktail: 29 Sep, 17:00–18:00 Showcase and drinks followed by a collective walk to the billboards in front of the main entrance of the University Open Saturdays: 26 Sep / 3 Oct, 11:00–18:00 Opening hours: Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna The collaborative works are on display at the AIL and on the billboards at the university’s main entrance on Oskar-Kokoschka-Platz. dieangewandte viennadesignweek applied.photography angewandte_id Feat

candidateAudit.text: What might consciousness smell like? Is it possible to sense interdependencies? Would you like to experience your embeddedness in the world? The SΫS SPACE prototype by artists duo MUELLER-DIVJAK opens its doors for two afternoons in September, inviting you for a one-of-a-kind experience, an exclusive multisensory trail of resonating with and better understanding of living systems. ⚡⚡⚡Currently all individual time slots are taken, but you can sign up for the waiting list! Find the link in our bio! Exclusive one-hour slot for a fascinating journey into your senses and search for a being that knows and feels everything about connectedness and interdependence. The artist and researcher duo MUELLER-DIVJAK (Dr. Jeanette Müller and Dr. Paul Divjak), who is working at the AIL with international artists and systems scientists on the FWF/PEEK project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenographies for Systems Awareness (Project lead: Mag. Alexandra Graupner; University of Applied Arts), is devoted to creating experiential multisensory spaces – the so called SΫS SPACEs – that help enhancing systems awareness through special sensory cues. Such allowing for coping resiliently with the complex interrelations and interactions that shape our world and all our lives. mueller_divjak dieangewandte

candidateAudit.title: A very special afternoon at Imadeya Ginza. My sincere thanks to Alejandro shogunsenbei for his generous hospitality, and to Israel Serralvo Caballero japanaffinity for taking me th
candidateAudit.text: A very special afternoon at Imadeya Ginza. My sincere thanks to Alejandro shogunsenbei for his generous hospitality, and to Israel Serralvo Caballero japanaffinity for taking me there and bringing us all together. It was a privilege to share the occasion with Tatsuya Fukuda, CEO of Tatsuya Brewery, and Toshihito Hayakawa, chief brewer of Tabica Brewery. I am deeply grateful for the warm welcome, the generous exchange and the opportunity to learn from people so deeply committed to sake. Moments like this remind me how much there is still to discover. Thank you for welcoming Kura Wien to one of Japan’s most respected sake destinations. 銀座のIMADEYAで、とても特別な午後を過ごしました。 温かくお迎えくださったAlejandroさん shogunsenbei、そして私を案内し、この素晴らしいご縁をつないでくださったIsrael Serralvo Caballeroさん japanaffinity に、心より感謝申し上げます。 Tatsuya Brewery CEOのTatsuya Fukudaさん、そしてTabica Breweryの杜氏、Toshihito Hayakawaさんとご一緒できたことを、大変光栄に思います。温かい歓迎と貴重なお話、そして日本酒に深い情熱を注ぐ皆さまから学ばせていただく機会に、心から感謝しています。 このようなひとときを通じて、日本酒の世界には、まだまだ学び、発見すべきことがたくさんあると改めて感じました。日本を代表する酒販店のひとつであるIMADEYAにKura Wienを迎えていただき、本当にありがとうございました。

candidateAudit.title: The Unsafe+Sounds festival, held annually in Vienna, returns in September with a kaleidoscopic program, offering a multifaceted glimpse into the contemporary music scene and AIL is
candidateAudit.text: The Unsafe+Sounds festival, held annually in Vienna, returns in September with a kaleidoscopic program, offering a multifaceted glimpse into the contemporary music scene and AIL is delighted to once again host one event in the program. unsafeandsounds AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna (Free entry) Overview: 18:30 Panel Discussion, unsafe+sounds in cooperation with the Weibel Institute for Digital Cultures (University of Applied Arts Vienna) weibel.institute Affective Histories Timotheus Vermeulen and Christian Höller in conversation with Sophie Publig History is never simply given. It is made through the scales and materials by which the past becomes legible: from sweeping narratives and historical events to gestures, sounds, images, technical infrastructures, and seemingly minor traces SOPHIE PUBLIG is a Senior Scientist researching digital ecosystems. Based at the Weibel Institute for Digital Cultures at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, she navigates the intricate networks of online territories. TIMOTHEUS VERMEULEN is Professor of Media, Culture and Society at the University of Oslo and joint director of the Media Aesthetics Research Group. He was a visiting scholar in Art History at Harvard in 2023–24 and will serve as joint Principal Investigator on a project on the politics of tone at the Centre for Advanced Study in Oslo in 2027–28. CHRISTIAN HÖLLER is editor and co-publisher of springerin – Hefte für Gegenwartskunst. Since 2024 he is head of the department Cross Disciplinary Strategies at the University of Applied Arts Vienna. cro

candidateAudit.title: Throughout August and September, the artist duo MUELLER-DIVJAK is residing at AIL for Summer Studio – using the space for artistic research, experimentation, and learning, developi
candidateAudit.text: Throughout August and September, the artist duo MUELLER-DIVJAK is residing at AIL for Summer Studio – using the space for artistic research, experimentation, and learning, developing the project's multisensory scenography – the so-called SΫS SPACE. Aim of the Summer Studio is to prepare the prototype of the scenography, which will be established at the AIL in June 2027 as the centerpiece of the final exhibition of the PEEK project ’SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS — Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness.’ The SΫS SPACE facilitates a physical experience of one's own embededdness within living systems, within complex interrelationships – within a greater whole. It paves the way for relational sensing and thinking – an embodied systems awareness, that can help in coping with complexity, challenges, and uncertainties, and in making good decisions towards sustainable futures. It deliberately reduces the dominance of the sense of sight, placing the emphasis instead on smell, touch, and hearing. Numerous scientists, as well as invited artists, politicians, journalists, children, senior citizens, curators, cultural workers, educators, and teenagers are individually guided through the immersive environment by Jeanette Müller and Paul Divjak and share their responses in photo-based reflections and semi-structured interviews. Their feedback directly informs the prototype. Save the date! 14 and 15 Sep 2026 The SΫS SPACE will open to the public in individual time slots for an exclusive multisensory experience. candidateAudit.text: Vienna’s most famous ALL YOU CAN PASTA is not a discount formula. It’s a philosophy🌱🍝 -The Pasta Specialists. 📲 Book now your table - Just click the link in our bio 📍Hollandstrasse 10/4-6, 1020 Wien 🕙Opening hours: every day from 11:30 to 22:00/22:15 There’s a stubborn prejudice around unlimited formulas: that in order to serve more, you inevitably have to serve worse. SoFàre’s All you can pasta starts from a simple and, in its own way, radical premise: the pasta that reaches your table during the unlimited formula is exactly the same pasta you would order à la carte. It’s not a formula: it’s a philosophy. And it has a very practical consequence for anyone sitting down at the table: you no longer have to choose between quality and affordability. What: A SURPRISE — the chef chooses the pasta shape. You decide how many courses to order. How much: each serving consists of 210g of fresh pasta, to be shared between two people. Price: €26.90 per person. Requirement: the experience is available by booking a table for at least two people. That detail about sharing isn’t a logistical constraint: it’s a declaration of intent. At SoFàre, the starting point is that food is at its best when it’s divided, discussed, passed from one plate to another. The chef’s surprise does the rest - a new flavour with every round, every dish a piece of Italy you didn’t know yet. The dough is made every day, with certified organic ingredients, carefully sourced between Italy and Austria from producers who share the same vision of food. candidateAudit.text: PISQU Pink Rabbit 🐰💗 Ein Cocktail mit Geschichte im Glas – unser Pink Rabbit startet mit Chicha Morada. Was ist Chicha Morada? Chicha Morada ist ein traditionelles peruanisches Getränk aus violettem Mais (Maíz Morado), gekocht mit Zimt, Nelken, Ananas Apfel und Limette. Das Ergebnis: eine tiefviolette, leicht süß-fruchtige Basis mit warmen Gewürznoten – in Peru seit Generationen beliebt, bei uns hausgemacht nach original Rezept. Aus dieser Basis wird mit Pisco und weiteren feinen Zutaten der Pink Rabbit – ein erfrischender Cocktail, der peruanische Tradition mit unserem P’isqu-Twist verbindet. Fruchtig, würzig, frisch. Lieben wir 📍 Große Pfarrgasse 5, 1020 Wien #pisquwien #leopoldstadt #1020 #piscococktails #1020

candidateAudit.text: 🔊 Sound on. The sound of guanciale hitting the pan and beginning to render. It’s a slow, uneven sound, and it cannot be rushed. Three peppers, in our case - because pepper isn’t an accessory here. It’s structural. Sichuan, Timut, black. candidateAudit.text: Granita Siciliana 🍋❄️ 200 g of sugar in 500 ml of water — let it melt over low heat (don’t boil). Add 250 ml of lemon juice, mix well, and pop it into the freezer. After 2 hours, stir it, then let it freeze overnight. The next day, blend it with a hand mixer until creamy — done. Perfect for breakfast with brioche or simply as a refreshing treat on hot days. ☀️ How do you cool down in this Vienna heat? ❄️🍦💦🌊

candidateAudit.title: PISQU Mate 🧉 Was ist Mate? Mate wird aus den Blättern des südamerikanischen Mate-Strauchs gewonnen und seit Jahrhunderten in Ländern wie Argentinien, Uruguay und Paraguay getrunke
candidateAudit.text: PISQU Mate 🧉 Was ist Mate? Mate wird aus den Blättern des südamerikanischen Mate-Strauchs gewonnen und seit Jahrhunderten in Ländern wie Argentinien, Uruguay und Paraguay getrunken – traditionell als starker Tee, bei uns als spannende Basis für erfrischende Drinks. Er hat einen erdig-herben Geschmack und enthält natürliches Koffein sowie Antioxidantien. Die Basis unseres Drinks: hausgemachter Mate, den wir selbst aufgebrüht haben – für den vollen, authentischen Geschmack ohne Umwege. Mate wirkt natürlich belebend, macht wach und konzentriert, ganz ohne den nervösen Flatter von Kaffee. Ein sanfter Energie-Kick, der einfach guttut. Kombiniert mit frischer Minze, Limette und einem Hauch Süße wird daraus ein erfrischender Begleiter für jede Tageszeit. Und das Beste: Ihr entscheidet – alkoholfrei für den klaren Kopf zwischendurch, oder mit Rum als frischer Mate Mojito für euren P’isqu-Genuss Moment am Abend. 🥂 📍 Große Pfarrgasse 5, 1020 Wien #pisquwien #leopoldstadt #matemojito #wienfoodguide #1020

candidateAudit.text: Here’s our Pesto Siciliano 🌱✨ Pesto siciliano, also known as pesto trapanese (or “agghiata trapanisa” in Sicilian), is a Sicilian twist on the classic pesto genovese, native to the Trapani area. It’s made with fresh, local ingredients - sun-dried tomatoes, almonds, pecorino, basil, olive oil, and salt - and in the traditional version, it’s made strictly by hand with a mortar and pestle, so the ingredients never heat up and their aromas and textures stay perfectly intact. Full honesty: we don’t always make it with the mortar and pestle, but whenever we can, we love bringing back this tradition and savoring every single step of this incredible sauce. Because the real pleasure starts way before the first bite. -The Pasta Specialists. 📲 Book now your table - Just click the link in our bio 📍Hollandstrasse 10/4-6, 1020 Wien 🕙Opening hours: every day from 11:30 to 22:00/22:15

candidateAudit.text: Ich suche eine Studiopartnerin für MEDICINA ✨ Du bist aus den Bereichen Yoga, Pilates, somatische Körperarbeit, Breathwork, Nervensystemregulation oder einem verwandten ganzheitlichen Ansatz? Ich wünsche mir jemanden, der Lust hat, gemeinsam ein Konzept aufzubauen aber eigenständig arbeiten möchte. Ich bringe die medizinische Perspektive ein, Du Deine Expertise rund um Körper, Bewegung und Bewusstsein. candidateAudit.text: Everything starts with something that already exists, in another form, in nature. It’s the product of planting, of harvests, of time given its due, of care. Long before it reaches the kitchen, an ingredient already has a story: the soil it grew in, the season that ripened it, the hands that tended it along the way. We choose high-quality products, grown in the right soil, handled the right way. But for us, quality doesn’t stop at the plate. We choose supply chains where every worker is protected the way they deserve to be: from the ground to the table, no shortcuts, no gray areas. Because a product can only really call itself good if it’s also good in the way it was brought here. It’s a slower choice, and a harder one. But it’s the only way we know how to do this. Carbonara, Pomo D’Oro, Pesto alla Genovese, Pesto Siciliano, Cacio & Pepe, Ajo, Ojo e Peperoncino - which is your favorite?✨ -The Pasta Specialists. 📲 Book now your table - Just click the link in our bio 📍Hollandstrasse 10/4-6, 1020 Wien 🕙Opening hours: every day from 11:30 to 22:00/22:15

candidateAudit.text: Das sind Yasemin & Theres. Ihnen gehört das Gartencafé und das schon seit über 13 Jahren. Seit einem Jahr ist Yasemin als Partnerin mit an Bord (allerdings schon seit 6 Jahren als Mitarbeiterin) und bringt jede Menge frischen Wind, neue Ideen und vor allem den Überblick über Reservierungen, Bestellungen & das tägliche Chaos mit. 🤗 Theres ist dafür meistens dort zu finden, wo es gut riecht: in unserer Mini-Küche. Weil wir uns so über den Community Award von 1000thingsinvienna freuen. Und daher DANKE an unsere Community und alle, die so fleißig für uns abgestimmt haben. Fotocredit: Theresa Komornyik

candidateAudit.title: 🍑 So macht ihr ganz einfach Umeboshi – Japanische eingelegte Pflaumen Ein Klassiker der japanischen Vorratsküche: Ume-Früchte werden in Salz eingelegt, fermentiert und in der Sonn
candidateAudit.text: 🍑 So macht ihr ganz einfach Umeboshi – Japanische eingelegte Pflaumen Ein Klassiker der japanischen Vorratsküche: Ume-Früchte werden in Salz eingelegt, fermentiert und in der Sonne getrocknet. Sauer, salzig, unverwechselbar. Zutaten: • Ume-Früchte (oder zb Wildpflaumen) (reif, gelblich), ca. 1 kg • Grobes Meersalz (siehe Salzrechner unten) • Optional: Rote Shiso-Blätter für die klassische rote Farbe • Optional: Shochu/Wodka zum Desinfizieren der Früchte Salzrechner (Salz in % vom Fruchtgewicht): 🧂 8–10 % → milder, moderner Umeboshi (weniger haltbar, kühl lagern) 🧂 15 % → klassisches Verhältnis, gute Balance 🧂 18–20 % → traditionell, sehr lange haltbar (Jahre bei Raumtemperatur) → Beispiel bei 1 kg Ume: 10 % = 100 g Salz | 15 % = 150 g Salz | 20 % = 200 g Salz Zubereitung: 1️⃣ Ume waschen, über Nacht wässern (entfernt Bitterstoffe), abtrocknen, Stiele entfernen 2️⃣ Früchte mit Shochu abreiben (Desinfektion) 3️⃣ Lagenweise mit Salz in ein sterilisiertes Gefäß schichten 4️⃣ Mit Gewicht beschweren (doppeltes Fruchtgewicht), luftdicht abdecken 5️⃣ 2–4 Wochen ziehen lassen, bis Umezu (Fruchtsaft) austritt 6️⃣ Shiso-Blätter salzen, Saft dazugeben für die typische rote Farbe 7️⃣ An 3 heißen Sommertagen tagsüber in der Sonne trocknen (Tsuyu-boshi ☀️) 8️⃣ Fertig! Monate bis Jahre haltbar #umeboshi #japanesefood #fermentation #pisqu #nikkeicuisine

candidateAudit.text: The exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory is still running till this Friday, July 10! Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 Last guided tour: Thur, July 9, 17:00 Memory is not a stable record of the past. Rather than functioning as a static archive, it unfolds as a dynamic process in which traces are continuously reshaped by perception, narration, and material conditions. Across these artistic approaches, [REVERBERATED] invites visitors to consider memory not as something simply preserved, but as something continuously produced through interactions between bodies, technologies, and environments. The exhibition thus explores how the past continues to reverberate within the systems of the present. With contributions by: Agustina Belén Agüero, Lobna Awidat, Phin Anibal, Rimon Alyagon Darr, Ronnie Danaher, Tatiana Del Valle, Hasti Ghasedi, Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz, Hanna Hofmann, Tal Horesh, Mauritius Itzinger, Laura Isselhorst, Dina Karaman, Moritz Klarer, Anna Buchner, Leonard Otterbein, David Ristić, Rajarshi Sarkar, Agnes Schyberg, Aryan Shahabian, Majedeh Shahvelayati, Mehrta Shirzadian, Pauline Simon, Laura Chalabi, People of Soil Photos: Lea Dörl

candidateAudit.title: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafi
candidateAudit.text: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafik In collaborative drawing, two people share a single pen – the line becomes a space of negotiation. A play between control and letting go. Who leads – and when? Impulse meets resistance, conviction meets empathy. Not always a conversation, but always an understanding – a dance on paper. These and other experiments are part of the course “Drawing: Here & Now” by Simon Goritschnig, in which students of the department Drawing and Printmaking explore various qualities of drawing beyond observational study. In the project “Reflex,” these experimental setups are set against observational drawing. Students draw in the cashier hall of the former Postsparkasse, intuitively picking up details from architecture and space, as well as situations of coming together: conversations, movements, gazes. In this process, it becomes visible how public and social space is visually probed and explored. The focus lies on reflection — with, through, and within drawing. With contributions by: Andrea Vairelles, Anna Marino, Beth Sorby, Emilia Schönwiese, Flora Schmid, Hannah Horn, Henriette Sonntag, Leo Hasslinger, Maria Lutkova, Max Offergeld, Nikolaus Kohout, Sophie Schweizer, Anija S Dartizio, Timo Pfeifer, Vera Kügel AIL in cooperation with the department Drawing and Printmaking and Simon Goritschnig Image: Henriette Sonntag Design: Atelier Dreibholz Concept Postcard Editions and Production: Eva Weber

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 4 Jul 2026, 15:00 The Geography of Yellow Walls Performance by Mehrta Shirzadian mehrrta Bright yellow becomes a quiet declaration of care, resistance, and return. Here, the body is reclaimed as homeland, shaped by experience rather than imposed borders. A performance unfolding through turmeric as healing material and the body as living territory. The work is rooted in a deep commitment to women’s health and critical scientific perspectives, engaging forms of embodied knowledge that have long been ignored or erased. The body becomes both evidence and memory, offering its own geography as a space of protection, defiance, and belonging. The performance is adapted to each site, responding to the spatial and contextual conditions of different venues. Mehrta Shirzadian is a performance and multimedia artist and artistic ­researcher working at the intersection of art and science. With a background in molecular biology, mathematics, and computer science, she creates participatory works exploring microbial life, sound, and bodily ecologies, addressing embodiment, agency, and the politics of representation. Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. candidateAudit.title: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alt
candidateAudit.text: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alternative investment platform that explores the cultural, economic, and emotional afterlife of the collapse of René Benko’s SIGNA empire. Through NFTs, merchandise, video works, and performative sales strategies, the project examines how value is produced through speculation, narrative, and collective belief. Originally developed through public interventions, the project was expanded through a student take over by Digitale Kunst. This exhibition presents new project strands developed by the students: an NFT series reflecting on financial dependency, a merchandise collection appropriating the aesthetics of startup culture and luxury branding, and a series of short-form videos combining influencer culture, promotional performance, and social commentary. Operating at the intersection of installation, performance, and participatory fiction, Renés Collapse Collection invites visitors to engage directly with the mechanisms of speculation, value production, and collapse. A project by by Zora Hünermann and Jakob Margit With contributions by: Ulrike Fritzsche, Koschka Cosmo Keye, Juarez Suarez, Ghanishka Kedar, Sei Jeung, Ghazal Naeimi, Dongjoo Kim, Jazzmin, Margherita Pruneti, Nicolás Henao Bonnet, Roma Bogdanov, and Grisha Terno.

candidateAudit.title: "Tell me more, tell me more…" 💌🌸 She got a note. She got a note! This summer at the Haven, we're trading the drive-in for a dyke-in — no apps, no algorithms, just handwritten let
candidateAudit.text: "Tell me more, tell me more…" 💌🌸 She got a note. She got a note! This summer at the Haven, we're trading the drive-in for a dyke-in — no apps, no algorithms, just handwritten letters, numbered strangers, and the kind of butterflies you thought only happened in a 1958 diner booth. How it works: Draw your number at the door as of 19.00. Write a note at one of our writing stations. Short messages to another number that caught your eye. Drop it in the mailbox at the bar — fold the card twice, write the recipient's number on the outside. Wait for delivery. Our team empties the mailbox every 20 minutes and passes notes on discreetly. Got a message? Write back, come say hi in person, or just smile to yourself. No message? Silence is a valid answer — try someone new. House rules: No names or contact details on the cards. Keep the notes you receive to yourself. Be kind, be creative, be yourself. Our awareness team is at the bar if you need us. Flowers, candles, ambient sound, and a room full of sapphics writing each other letters. That's the whole pitch. 📅 10.07.2026 ⏰ as of 19.00 📍 Last Little Haven, Gumpendorferstraße 68, 1060 Vienna

candidateAudit.text: We present to you: Felix Deiters - "Miss Diagnosis" The opening starts 26.06.2026 as of 18:00 with an artist talk at 20:00. The exhibition runs from 26.06.2026 until 17.07.2026. Felix Deiters is a visual artist currently living and working in Berlin. His interest in the field spanning between the gendered, the medical and the vulnerable body in relation to structural power dynamics is supported by his lived experiences as a trans person and takes shape in objects, installations and through text. His upcoming show Miss Diagnosis features two series of works that literally and figuratively asks questions about the limits of resilience, medical misogyny and gaslighting. What tools are afforded to those who want to overcome deeply rooted beliefs about chronic illness or exhaustion under capitalism being imagined, instead of being made invisible?

candidateAudit.text: 🎬 PRIDE MONTH GIVEAWAY 🏳️‍🌈 Win 2 tickets to the PREVIEW of THE WATERMELON WOMAN — June 19th, 19:30 at Stadtkino Wien! Thanks to Stadtkino Wien stadtkinowien, we're giving away a pair of tickets to a very special kick off screening and afterdiscussion for the movie The Watermelon Woman by Cheryl Dunye cheryldunye . Truly, one of the most important landmarks of queer cinema and a film that's also part of Last Little Haven's archive collection 💛 About THE WATERMELON WOMAN: Cheryl — young, Black and lesbian — works at a Philadelphia video store and shoots wedding videos on the side. Sifting through old films from the 30s and 40s, she spots a supporting actress in a Southern melodrama credited only as "The Watermelon Woman." Intrigued, she starts digging — and hits a startling void: almost nothing is documented about Black actresses of that era. Determined to close this gap in film history, she's up against inaccessible archives, tight-lipped witnesses, and an affair with an attractive colleague that makes her life anything but easy. A Black lesbian woman makes a film about a Black lesbian woman who wants to make a film about a Black lesbian woman — it sounds cerebral, but turns out to be a light-footed, funny and self-reflexive mockumentary about the invisibility of Black, queer film history and the desire to see oneself reflected in it. ✨ HOW TO ENTER ✨ 💬 Tag the person you'd take to the cinema 👇 ❤️ Follow lastlittlehaven 🏆 We'll announce the winner via DM at 18:00 on June 16th — just enough time to grab your plus-one and make it to the screening. Keep an eye on your D

candidateAudit.text: Wir freuen uns die Ausstellung "Fuck Kehrarbeit" von Lucia Berlanga am 29.05.2026 anzukündigen. Die Ausstellung öffnet ab 18:00 Uhr - das Künstlergespräch findet um 19:00 Uhr statt- und ist bis zum 19.06.2026 jeden Freitag ab 18:00 Uhr zu sehen. Über Lucia Berlanga: Lucia Berlangas Kunst transformiert Schmerz in eine neue, fließende Stärke. Sie ist ein Manifest für die Rückeroberung von Autonomie und die utopische Kraft von Verbundenheit. Ihre Arbeiten rufen dazu auf, zu erwachen — zu erkennen, dass die vermeintliche Bestimmung ein Konstrukt zu unserem Nachteil war, und stattdessen eine neue, eigene Definition von Stärke zu entwickeln. Es ist eine dringende Notwendigkeit, diese Erzählungen zu hinterfragen, den Schmerz der Unterdrückung zu transformieren und gemeinsam einen Ort zu gestalten, an dem wir uns wahrhaftig begegnen können.

candidateAudit.title: Letztes Wochenende ist uns etwas Besonderes bewusst geworden. Zwei Tage lang waren nur offene, herzliche und liebe Menschen bei uns im Café. Gerade in einer Stadt wie Wien, wissen
candidateAudit.text: Letztes Wochenende ist uns etwas Besonderes bewusst geworden. Zwei Tage lang waren nur offene, herzliche und liebe Menschen bei uns im Café. Gerade in einer Stadt wie Wien, wissen wir zu gut, dass es auch anders sein kann. Und vielleicht ist genau das das eigentliche Ziel hinter unserer Idee. Ein Raum verändert Menschen. Atmosphäre verändert Begegnungen. Wenn Menschen sich sicher, entschleunigt und willkommen fühlen, begegnen sie sich anders. Wir wollen keinen Ort für Coolness, Status oder Selbstdarstellung schaffen. Sondern einen Ort, an dem man durchatmet. Wo Menschen freundlich sind. Offen. Echt. Vielleicht ist das der wahre Luxus der Zukunft: In einem Raum voller guter Energie und guter Menschen zu sein. Wir freuen uns auf kommendes Wochenende und viele offene, mutige und nette Menschen begrüßen zu dürfen ❤️

candidateAudit.text: Wir leben in einer Welt voller Lärm, Reizüberflutung und permanenter Erreichbarkeit. Und vielleicht ist genau das der Grund, warum sich so viele Menschen innerlich erschöpft fühlen. Bewusster zu leben bedeutet nicht, perfekt oder spirituell zu sein. Es bedeutet, wieder zu spüren: Was brauche ich gerade wirklich? Ruhe. Verbindung. Ein echtes Gespräch. Einen Ort, an dem nichts von dir erwartet wird. Wir glauben: Bewusstsein schafft Verbindung — zu sich selbst, zu anderen und zum eigenen Leben. Deshalb haben wir Offline Oida eröffnet.

candidateAudit.text: Passend zum heutigen Frühlingsbeginn, darf’s ruhig ein bisserl orange werden. 🍊🌷 Unsere Orangen-Lebkuchen-Spezialitäten bringen Sonne ins Herz und fruchtige Frühlingsfreude auf den Tisch. Ob Orangen Taler, Orangen Lebkuchen oder Arancini – fein würziger Lebkuchen trifft hier auf die frisch-liebliche Note sonnengereifter Orange. A must-do experience if you are passionate about history and tradition. Compared to other cafes, maybe a bit more expensive but it’s worth it! 🧁Demel - fantastic café close to Hofburg. Their strong piece (and the best in Vienna 😉) is the Kaiserscmharnn, “the emperor’s sweet omelette”, one of the most iconic desserts in Austria. Even here you have to be patient and queue up before entering ☕️Café Diglas - An authentic corner of Vienna, where tradition lives without flattery. Informal atmosphere, excellent desserts and polite and very helpful staff. candidateAudit.text: Dein neues Zuhause für Bewegung & Herzlichkeit! 💫 Unser Medicina Studio im Herzen des 7. Bezirks ist weit mehr als nur eine Location. Es ist ein Raum für echte Begegnung, in dem Gesundheit, Körperarbeit und menschliche Verbindung im Mittelpunkt stehen. Wir suchen Verstärkung! Unser Team besteht nicht nur aus Experten, sondern vor allem aus Herzensmenschen und Freunden, die eine gemeinsame Vision teilen. Um unser Angebot im Bereich sportliche Bewegung zu erweitern, suchen wir motivierte Trainer:innen, die unsere Leidenschaft für Dynamik, Kraft und Technik teilen. Du passt perfekt zu uns, wenn du Classes leitest in: = Yoga = Pilates = Functional Training & Mobility = Somatic Movement Was dich bei uns erwartet: Bei uns findest du nicht nur ein wunderschönes Studio mit klassischem Wiener Altbau-Charme. Dich erwartet ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und gemeinsam wachsen möchte. Wir bieten dir den idealen Kraftplatz, um deine Impulse zu setzen und Menschen auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Wohlbefinden zu begleiten. Bewirb dich jetzt! Hast du Lust, Teil unserer Medicina-Familie zu werden? Dann schreib uns einfach an office@medicina.wien – wir freuen uns darauf, dich und deine Vision kennenzulernen! 🤍 Medicina Studio | Lerchenfelder Straße, 1070 Wien

candidateAudit.text: One of my favorite places is Crete is a tiny beach called Afrata. Once on the way there I stopped at a Taverna where I had a salad with μαυρομάτικα φασόλια aka black eyed beans, smoked fish and herbs. Fresh, delicious, intense and very flavorful. I needed to bring the same flavors home. Kias worked on a recipe that would give us some Cretan feelings here in Vienna. It’s tastes like holidays and throws me back to the good Greek summer days. Have you tried our Afrata Salata yet? If not, I’d love to serve it to you soon. I am looking forward to a new week kafeneon_bistrot Have a great Sunday Alex and Kafeneon Team Pic: Vini Valpereiro

candidateAudit.text: 09.02.2024 - 09.02.2025 One year ago today, SicilEat began its journey—a dream built on the flavors, scents, and traditions of Sicily. Now, it’s a reality, and that’s all thanks to you 🧡 • Every time you choose our products, send us a message, or tell us, “This took me back to Sicily”, you remind us why we do what we do. Your support and feedback have helped us grow every step of the way. • So, from the bottom of our hearts, thank you. Thank you to those who believed in us from the start and to those who joined us along the way. Thank you to everyone who tastes and shares SicilEat with a friend. • This is just the beginning, and we can’t wait to continue this journey with you 🍊 Marco & Roberto The SicilEat Team — Vor genau einem Jahr begann die Reise von SicilEat – ein Traum, der auf den Aromen, Düften und Traditionen Siziliens basiert. Heute ist er Realität, und das verdanken wir euch 🧡 • Jedes Mal, wenn ihr unsere Produkte wählt, uns eine Nachricht sendet oder sagt „Das hat mich nach Sizilien zurückversetzt“, erinnert ihr uns daran, warum wir das tun, was wir tun. Eure Unterstützung und euer Feedback haben uns auf jedem Schritt dieser Reise wachsen lassen. • Deshalb möchten wir von ganzem Herzen Danke sagen. Danke an alle, die von Anfang an an uns geglaubt haben, und an diejenigen, die unterwegs zu uns gestoßen sind. Danke an alle, die probieren und SicilEat mit Freunden teilen. • Das ist erst der Anfang, und wir freuen uns darauf, diese Reise mit euch fortzusetzen 🍊 Marco & Roberto The SicilEat Team
